domain: storage | devices | events | integrity | boot | power | network | security | performance | software | system
title: one line, specific, names the actual object
initial_state: state at first classification; omit if unchanged
local_evidence: what was observed, with the evidence pointer - file plus filter, not the data itself
lifecycle_context: first seen, last seen, whether it predates a hardware or software change
external_evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/... - what this source actually establishes
conclusion: root cause, only when the evidence justifies one
recommended_action: required when state is action or critical
approval: reference to the operator approval, if the action was performed
verification: the independent post-change check and its result
remaining_uncertainty: required when confidence is UNKNOWN, or when action/critical has no recommended_action. State the next discriminating test.
budget_note: set when this finding was deliberately deferred to stay within budget, and say what would resolve it
